links.outcome: Quality of LLM uncertainty estimates (verbalized confidence, token logits) for pre-test diagnostic probability
links.effect: Verbalized Confidence and Token Logits underperformed the XGB baseline; LLM Embedding+XGB came closest. Authors conclude LLMs fall short of reliable pre-test probability estimation and need improved calibration.
links.quote: LLM Embedding+XGB showed the closest performance to the XGB baseline, while Verbalized Confidence and Token Logits underperformed.

links.outcome: LLM-based diagnostic probability estimation compared with a traditional ML classifier on the same EHR data
links.effect: The XGB classifier outperformed the LLM-based methods across all three tasks (Sepsis, Arrhythmia, CHF).
links.quote: The XGB classifier outperformed the LLM-based methods across all tasks.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance on pre-test diagnostic probability and specifically compares deployment-level uncertainty estimation methods (verbalized confidence, token logits, embedding classifier) for calibration and reliability.
